newsitem.title: USA: NY Public Service Commissioner Jerry to retire.
newsitem.headline: NY Public Service Commissioner Jerry to retire.

text.p: Commissioner Harold A. Jerry Jr announced Wednesday he will retire from the New York State Public Service Commission when his term expires on January 31, the commission said.
He was first appointed to the commission in 1973, served as chairman in 1995, and is the second longest tenured commissioner since the creation of the Public Service Commission in 1907.

Commissioner Jerry is an avid environmentalist who served as executive secretary of the Temporary Study Commission on the Future of the Adirondacks, whose report led to the creation of the Adirondack Park Agency.

Prior to his appointment to the commission, Commissioner Jerry served as director and counsel of the Temporary Commission on the State Court System, whose report was released in January 1973. Jerry was also a commissioner on the Commission on the Adirondacks in the 21st Century.
